chapter.title: Toolchain
chapter.simpara: The documentation toolchain consists of bundled tools, which are checked into the repository under documentation/tools/, and runtime dependencies, which must be installed separately.

listitem.simpara: XSLT processor used to run transformations. Located at documentation/tools/saxon/.
RELAX NG validator. Located at documentation/tools/jing/.
Compiles Schematron schemas into XSLT validation stylesheets, run with Saxon. Located at documentation/tools/schematron/schxslt2/.
Required to run Saxon and Jing. Install OpenJDK 21 via your system package manager (for example, default-jdk on Debian-based systems).
Required for XSD validation. Available as part of the libxml2-utils package on Debian-based systems.
